original_test_intent: Sustain simultaneous GPU, CPU, memory, storage and network stress for 48 hours and verify no tool, platform or service failure.
original_method: Validate licensed BurnInTest package/version/checksum/config and exact GPU/CPU/memory/HDD/network modules; map safe storage and network peers; define per-domain load floors, exact common 48-hour overlap, evidence cadence/capacity and abort/recovery; preserve baselines; stage with confirmation, run all domains concurrently under monitoring, then clean up and restore.
manual_activity: Operator provides/licences package, validates Task Manager/device load, supervises 48-hour run and recovery.
required_inputs: All domain modules and load floors
safety_requirements: Abort on data error, thermal/power, RAS/XID, link/service or heartbeat failure
agent_execution_scope: May validate package/plan and analyze artifacts
Must not assume commercial binary, target disks or start 48-hour run without confirmation
